connector.name: Albyhub Admin MCP
connector.registryDescription: Admin an Alby Hub Lightning node from an agent: info, balances, channels; safety-gated writes.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package albyhub-admin-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the llmops-pro account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
